symptom: `change $i (Lbl = toString(minutesBetween($a, $b)))` with Lbl String(10) passed check and built; at runtime the Decimal rendered as ~43 characters and overflowed the attribute
cause: MDL041 only judged Decimal into Integer/Long targets; nothing related a toString's argument kind to the target attribute's length, which the no-project validator cannot see
insight: A multi-item expression report goes stale item by item: re-run each repro on main before coding — four of the six items in #1397 had already been fixed by separate PRs. The remaining one needs BOTH halves established (argument provably Decimal via exprcheck inference, attribute provably bounded via script decl or stored StringAttributeType.Length>0; Length 0 is unlimited), so it lives in the --references pass and warns rather than refuses, since mxbuild accepts it. Also: the unquoted `[%CurrentDateTime%]` in a retrieve where is stored quoted, so the reported CE0161 no longer reproduces.
